subject: Private offer MAP (GCP) — acceptance runway, eval checkpoints & billing path
messages:
From: Elsa Meyer <elsa.meyer@novushealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Grant <tom.grant@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — MAP and procurement constraints

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Tom and I discussed next steps with procurement and we want to capture a clear acceptance path so our finance team can move the PO through approvals. High level constraints:

- We must receive a Marketplace Private Offer (GCP) invoice path that ties to a single committed SKU.
- Our procurement cycle requires a mutual action plan with clear eval gates (technical acceptance, security sign-off, pilot results) and the final invoicing milestone.
- SOC2 evidence or summary is required for initial approval.

Can you share a suggested MAP with timelines and call out which milestones require vendor sign-off vs internal sign-off? Also good to know whether Redwood can accept a GCP Marketplace PO or if you need a direct invoice to a Redwood billing account.

Elsa
Senior Director, Platform Ops
NovusHealth

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elsa Meyer <elsa.meyer@novushealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — MAP and procurement constraints

Thanks Elsa — looping in Grace (AM) and Karthik (commercial) to align on billing options.

Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan tailored for a GCP Private Offer flow. Key points in the MAP (see attachment):
- Week 0–1: Admin kickoff + access (redwood onboarding checklist)
- Week 2–4: Pilot evaluation (3 workload types, pass/fail criteria included)
- Week 5: Technical acceptance window (logs & perf targets validated)
- Week 6: Security doc handoff (SOC2 summary + audit contacts)
- Week 7: Billing milestone and PO submission -> invoice generation

Billing options:
- Preferred: GCP Marketplace Private Offer (novus will accept a single committed SKU and GCP will pass payment to Redwood). This simplifies PO processing on your side.
- Alternate: Direct invoicing to Redwood with a net-30 invoice (requires an SOW addendum).

I attached the MAP spreadsheet, a short SOC2 summary, and a doc with Marketplace PO specs for your procurement team.

Would Thursday 3/22 for a 30-min run-through work? I can walk through milestones and sign-off points.

Best,
Mateo
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 20280319_Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx] [Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf] [Attachment: Redwood-Marketplace-PO-Specs.docx]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Elsa Meyer <elsa.meyer@novushealth.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — MAP and procurement constraints

Hi Elsa — quick notes from an account/runbook perspective:

- We recommend marking Technical Acceptance as a joint checkpoint: our infra team verifies throughput/latency against the agreed test prompts and your engineering team confirms functional correctness.
- For billing, if you go through GCP Private Offer we ask for the marketplace PO ID (we will reconcile that to the Redwood commitment). If procurement requires invoicing to a Novus vendor number, we can accept a direct invoice but that adds ~2 weeks to processing.
- For pilot metrics, we included pass/fail thresholds in the MAP; if you'd like we can convert those to JIRA tickets for traceability.

I'll run the pilot acceptance verification and act as the single point for technical sign-off. Mateo — tag legal when you want contract language changes.

Thanks —
Grace
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Grant <tom.grant@novushealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Elsa Meyer <elsa.meyer@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — MAP and procurement constraints

Thanks — procurement had a few clarifying questions after reviewing the MAP & PO spec doc:

1) If we route via GCP Private Offer, will Redwood accept the GCP invoice as final (no separate Redwood invoice)?
2) What is the cancellation policy inside the Marketplace offer (we need a 30-day opt-out for our legal team).
3) Can Redwood provide a short one-page SOC2 attestation (we cannot share full reports broadly)?

Procurement also asked if Redwood can pre-populate the Marketplace SKU with a commit that matches our internal cost center, that would make approvals faster.

We'd like to lock the MAP timeline this week if possible.

Tom
VP, IT Operations
NovusHealth

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Grant <tom.grant@novushealth.com>, Elsa Meyer <elsa.meyer@novushealth.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — MAP and procurement constraints

Hi Tom / Elsa —

Quick answers from legal:

1) Yes — when the private offer is accepted through GCP and the PO ID is provided, GCP's remittance to Redwood is treated as the final payment. We will include language in the contract stating acceptance of Marketplace PO remittance.
2) Cancellation: our standard Marketplace private-offer terms include a 30-day termination right on either party with prorated billing for any unused committed units; we can surface that in the MAP as a single-line item.
3) SOC2: happy to provide a one-page attestation and a named contact for audit questions. The SOC2 Summary attached earlier is the searchable overview; we will not share full reports without an NDA.

I'll prepare a short clause set to drop into the SOW and confirm the termination language. Also, if procurement wants the SKU pre-populated with a cost-center string, we'll coordinate with our marketplace operations to add the mapping — we need the exact string you want.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf]

From: Elsa Meyer <elsa.meyer@novushealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com, Tom Grant <tom.grant@novushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood private offer — MAP and procurement constraints

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is great.

Action items agreed:
- Novus to confirm preferred cost-center string by EOD Thursday (we will send to Mateo).
- Redwood to confirm Marketplace PO reconciliation step and drop 30-day termination line in SOW (Laura).
- Schedule 3/22 10:00am PT for the MAP walkthrough (30 min) — Mateo to send calendar invite.
- Procurement to review SOC2 attestation and issue PO after cost-center mapping is confirmed.

We are good to lock the MAP timeline pending the minor contract language and the cost-center string. Thanks, team.

Elsa
Senior Director, Platform Ops
NovusHealth
